ms.report:
(A) Use Case Research Report (PDF)
This document presents the strategic rationale and practical implementation of a Satellite Oracle system to support smallholder farmers in India. It describes how Earth Observation data and blockchain infrastructure will enhance the capabilities of Agri-Entrepreneurs (AEs), enabling land verification, sustainability tracking, and data-driven advisory services. The report includes a phased rollout plan and outlines future pathways for financial integration.
https://github.com/HashPoint/pcf13-satellite-oracle-syngenta/blob/6bd48ee2eb2e32ff5aba5bff608ce18209e4e4df/Milestone1/UseCaseResearchReport.pdf
(B) Architecture & Project Plan (PDF and Markdown)
This artifact defines the technical architecture, data flow, system components, and blockchain interaction design for the Satellite Oracle. It includes API specifications, oracle data structures, and the integration plan with the Agri-Entrepreneur Digital Diary (AEDD) mobile app. In addition to the PDF we provide the same content in markdown format for better readability. 
PDF: https://github.com/HashPoint/pcf13-satellite-oracle-syngenta/blob/6bd48ee2eb2e32ff5aba5bff608ce18209e4e4df/Milestone1/Design%20document%20and%20Project%20Plan.pdf
Markdown: https://github.com/colll78/Syngenta-Oracle/tree/main

In addition here are a few links which demonstrate stakeholder's engagement in the design phase and the considerable effort we've invested towards ensuring that the project will cater to the target users -
